capabilities: Import answers and articles from a Zhihu favorites folder as Markdown notes
Authenticate via QR-code login or manually pasted cookies
Localize article images and paginate through favorites while skipping duplicates
Classify notes with an OpenAI-compatible or Anthropic API and write ai_category, ai_summary and tags
Prevent duplicate notes with stable type-and-ID filenames
extras: Desktop-only (does not load on mobile); the README warns that cookies and API keys are sensitive and should not be shared, and that Zhihu's unofficial web endpoints may change and break the plugin.
problem: Zhihu offers no stable public API, so saved answers and articles cannot be imported into Obsidian as full-text Markdown notes.

relations.evidence: 也可以使用 BRAT 或符号链接进行开发安装。

summary: Syncs answers and articles from a Zhihu favorites folder into Obsidian as Markdown files with YAML metadata and optional AI categorization.
